title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT BS Admissions – Spring 2026
text:
IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT

BS Admissions – Spring 2026

All students who have applied for BS Admissions (Spring 2026) are advised to check their admission status on the official admissions portal:

admissions.awkum.edu.pk (https://admissions.awkum.edu.pk)

Selected candidates must deposit their admission fee to confirm their admission on or before

22nd January 2026

Important Information:

No University Visit Required:
Students do NOT need to visit the university for fee payment.

Online Payment Available:
An online fee payment option is available to save time and facilitate students.

— Directorate of Admissions & FAD, AWKUM
